# Soulsteads

> Open-source tools for running AI agents on your own infrastructure. Keep the agent you already use and add only what you need: versioned agent configuration, chat access, work tracking, or model routing. Agent Forge runs workflows independently.

The tools install separately. There is no shared installer, database, or credential store. Use the release catalog for downloads, checksums, and version-matched instructions. The setup links below are for current source unless noted.

## Getting started

- [Start here](https://soulsteads.github.io/soulsteads/#start-here): Choose a first task and its setup guide. If you are just exploring, Workboard’s local SQLite quickstart needs no model, chat account, or database server.
- [Soulsteads README](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads/blob/main/README.md): Product boundaries, release status, and links to the agent setup and connection skills.

- [Offline setup planner](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads#print-a-setup-plan): Print requirements, release downloads, and the corresponding guide for one tool without installing anything.

## Setup guides

- [Agent Home](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-agent-home/blob/main/README.md#get-started): Keep instructions, skills, and configuration in a private Git-tracked home. Home does not install, authenticate, or sandbox the agent harness.
- [Agent Messaging](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-agent-messaging/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#before-you-start): Connect a supported, already-authenticated coding agent to chat. Choose a connector and configure its sender allowlist before starting it.
- [Agent Workboard](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-agent-workboard/blob/main/README.md#quickstart): Create a project and a ready issue, then read the board back. Workboard coordinates work; it does not execute it.
- [Model Router](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-model-router/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md#prerequisites): Route requests to an inference server you already run. Check the guide for the supported listener modes and backend requirements.

- [Agent Forge quick start](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-agent-forge/blob/main/README.md#quick-start): Run a two-step workflow, inspect its result, and optionally schedule it. The example uses a dedicated PostgreSQL database, but no model or agent harness.
- [Agent Home: preview a Hermes import](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-agent-home/blob/e52aaa5bafc83af51848f1bd4d787e9c64cc8913/docs/hermes-import.md): Use the reviewed release guide to inspect a profile without changing it or creating a new home. Applying an import is separate.
- [Agent Skillstore](https://github.com/soulsteads/soulsteads-agent-skillstore/blob/main/README.md#quickstart): Review, install, and recover versioned skills. Try the local quickstart without a harness or model account, or use tracking-only mode for private backups.

## Optional

- [Agent-assisted setup](https://soulsteads.github.io/soulsteads/#start): Find the setup and connection skills and a prompt for using them. Keep credentials private and get approval before starting services or making live requests.
